name: Higanbana
source:
A high schooler who aspires to be a doctor arrives at the hospital his grandfather operates for a two-week long vacation. Little does he know that these two weeks will permanently change his life ...

[From [url=http://www.insani.org/radiata.html]Insani[/url]]
translation:
一名立志成为医生的高中生来到祖父经营的医院度过两周的长假。他几乎不知道这两周将永久改变他的生活……

[来自[url=http://www.insani.org/radiata.html]Insani[/url]]
